entries.evidence: AgentHub uses the pinned gorilla/websocket Upgrader with nil CheckOrigin. Its documented and inspected implementation substitutes checkSameOrigin: a present Origin must parse and its host (including port) must equal the request Host; otherwise Upgrade returns 403. No Origin is intentionally allowed for the outbound Go client, not anonymous access: Handler.sourceAgentChannel first rejects cross-site/same-site Fetch Metadata and requires the cluster-bound registration bearer token; viewer cookies alone cannot authorize this route. No unconditional CheckOrigin override exists. TestFleetChannelOriginAndBearerBoundary exercises this reachable route with foreign/opaque/malformed origins, allowed same/no-origin clients, cross-site metadata and invalid bearer. This disposition covers the missing-origin-check audit only, not overall channel authorization or production readiness.
